FROM python:3.11-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY pyproject.toml poetry.lock* ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir poetry && \
    poetry config virtualenvs.create false && \
    poetry install --only=main --no-interaction --no-ansi

FROM python:3.11-slim
RUN useradd --create-home appuser
WORKDIR /home/appuser

COPY --from=builder /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages
COPY --from=builder /usr/local/bin /usr/local/bin

COPY --chown=appuser:appuser src/ ./src/

USER appuser
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "myapp.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

version: '3.8'

services:
  app:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - ./src:/home/appuser/src  # hot reload
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@db:5432/app
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
    depends_on:
      - db
      - redis
    command: uvicorn myapp.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0

  db:
    image: postgres:15
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: user
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: pass
      POSTGRES_DB: app
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"

volumes:
  pgdata:

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
          POSTGRES_DB: test
        ports: ["5432:5432"]
        options: >-
          --health-cmd="pg_isready"
          --health-interval=10s
          --health-timeout=5s
          --health-retries=5

    steps:


        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: "pip"

        run: |
          pip install poetry
          poetry config virtualenvs.create false
          poetry install --with=dev --no-interaction

        run: |
          poetry run ruff check src/
          poetry run black --check src/
          poetry run mypy src/

        run: |
          poetry run pytest --cov=src --cov-report=xml --cov-fail-under=80
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://test:test@localhost:5432/test

        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          files: ./coverage.xml
```

name: Docker

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

    steps:


        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
          tags: |
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
            type=sha

        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
```

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: myapp
  labels:
    app: myapp
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: myapp
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: myapp
    spec:
      containers:

          image: ghcr.io/user/myapp:v1.2.3
          ports:

          envFrom:

                name: myapp-secrets

                name: myapp-config
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "256Mi"
              cpu: "250m"
            limits:
              memory: "512Mi"
              cpu: "500m"
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5

---

1. **Dockerize**: создайте multi-stage Dockerfile для FastAPI приложения
2. **CI Pipeline**: настройте GitHub Actions с тестами, линтерами, coverage
3. **K8s Deploy**: напишите манифесты Deployment, Service, Ingress, HPA
4. **Helm Chart**: упакуйте приложение в Helm чарт с values для dev/staging/prod
5. **Monitoring**: добавьте /metrics, настройте Prometheus + Grafana дашборд

---

| Ошибка | Правильно |
|--------|-----------|
| Запуск контейнера от root | `USER appuser` в Dockerfile |
| Нет health checks | livenessProbe + readinessProbe |
| Хардкод секретов в манифестах | Secret / External Secrets Operator |
| Нет resource limits | requests/limits на CPU и память |
| Один реплика в продакшене | Минимум 3, HPA настроен |
| Отсутствие 롤лбэка | Стратегия деплоя (RollingUpdate/Canary) |

key_takeaways: Главная идея: SQLAlchemy 2.0, Alembic, асинхронность, связи, загрузка — это фундамент для GIL, Reference Counting, Декораторы.
Понимание > запоминание. Разбирайте каждую строку кода.
Ошибки — это нормально. Важно уметь их читать и исправлять.
Официальная документация — ваш лучший друг. Всегда актуальна.
Практика даёт навык. Напишите 3 своих примера после урока.
